notes: All five arm joints may coordinate; the gripper remains fixed to hold the nozzle.

Coordinated mode prefers visible balanced joint participation among candidates within 15% of the lowest evaluated contact/persistence score and the duration/travel limits, and never above the unchanged baseline exposure.
Spans saturate at the stated targets. Loops, reversals and extra travel do not earn unlimited reward.
Efficient mode selects the original persistence + 0.05 * duration objective. Coordinated mode is a presentation preference, not proof of greater optimality.
Hard constraints, endpoint, plant weights and timing limits stay authoritative. Finite sampled validation is required before replay.
